name: Karasutengu
source: A pure youkai. He's Yatakaru's longest-serving personnel. Consequently his abilities are guaranteed up to for this task; he works as a butler for him. Karasutengu's character is calm, he reproves Yatakarasu often. He was also the one who taught the Yata Raiten style to Katou Kotarou.
